summary: Mergeable PR that fixes a long-standing issue with form field error messages, but requires minor documentation updates.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by using `copy.deepcopy` instead of the more idiomatic `self.error_messages.copy()`.
The PR does not include any additional tests to ensure the fix does not introduce regressions or edge cases.
The patch does not update the docstring or comments to reflect the change in behavior.
